title: G006 baseline vs push curriculum with five training seeds at the G006S1 push grid
question: With five training seeds per variant, does the push-curriculum policy recover from 2.0/2.5/3.0 m/s body-frame pushes at a different rate than the baseline policy?

design.why_reuse: Training source bytes, entrypoint, task, budget and evaluator are identical to G006, so seeds 42-44 are the same experiment; only seeds 45 and 46 are trained.
design.known_command_difference: The current run_training.ps1 passes an explicit '--device cuda:0'. G006 ran with the AppLauncher default, which its stdout recorded as cuda:0. The gate requires the new stdout to show 'Using device: cuda:0'.

training.harness: scripts/run_training.ps1 without Qualification/Smoke/safety switches and without Hydra overrides
gates: harness report passed == true (same eight run-health checks as G006)
training source bundle sha256 equals base.training_source_bundle_sha256 before and after the run
recorded command equals the G006 command with seed, run_name and the documented '--device cuda:0' as the only differences
training.on_gate_failure: stop the queue, keep every artifact, record the failure; an incomplete run is restarted from scratch under a new run name only after the cause is recorded

evaluation.grid_source: fixed by G006S1 pre-registered selection; not re-selected here
evaluation.protocol_equivalence: every report's protocol sha256 must equal the G006S1 phase-B reports' protocol sha256

analysis.primary: paired hierarchical bootstrap of push_curriculum minus baseline recovery over the 1080 grid trials, seeds 42-46, 108 strata, 10000 draws, bootstrap seed 20260824
analysis.difference_claim_rule: state a direction only if the primary 95% CI excludes 0; otherwise report no detectable difference
secondary: per-magnitude and per-direction pooled recovery with Wilson 95% intervals
same paired delta for seeds 45-46 only (not used to select anything)

claim_boundary: Five training seeds per variant; the result is about these two training recipes in simulation, not about real robots.
Both variants saw pushes of at most 1.0 m/s in training; the 2.0-3.0 m/s grid is outside both training distributions.
Recovery after a push is not getting up from a fallen posture.

resource_gates.gpu_lease: %USERPROFILE%\CodexSignals\Use-GpuLease.ps1 owner G006S2, one lease per training run and per evaluation
